title: Check if the i-th bit is Set or Not
statementHtml: Given two integers n and i, return true if the ith bit in the binary representation of n (counting from the least significant bit, 0-indexed) is set (i.e., equal to 1). Otherwise, return false.
examples:
Input: n = 5, i = 0

Output: true

Explanation: Binary representation of 5 is 101. The 0-th bit from LSB is set (1).

Input: n = 10, i = 1

Output: true

Explanation: Binary representation of 10 is 1010. The 1-st bit from LSB is set (1).
